title: Reapportioned envelope morphology-authority canary
campaign_question: Does the operator's more anatomically specific envelope retain its newly authored cranial, cervical, scapular, pelvic, and hind-limb organization under deformable and rigid FLUX elaboration?

revised_source.custody_note: Exact operator-provided Image 4 screenshot, preserved without crop, cleanup, or rerender.

conditions.prompt: This creature made of fitted stone plates.

known_confound: The revised screenshot does not reproduce the original source camera, framing, resolution, or viewport lighting exactly. Cross-source differences can support directional morphology-authority evidence but cannot attribute every output delta solely to geometry revision.
claim_ceiling: The four paired outputs can show whether the revised source visibly carries more of its authored organization through both material prompts. They cannot independently estimate a geometry-only effect size or establish production generality.
expansion_predicate: Expand the revised source to armor and shell only if at least one revised cell preserves the newly authored cranial, neck-to-scapula, pelvic, and hind-limb organization without a material silhouette regression relative to its original-source comparator.
visual_review: Inspect all four comparator and revised outputs together. Present both conditioning sources, exact prompts, seed, settings, effective routes, outputs, and morphology-survival judgments in one sheet.
